targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  long_name AS "Node Name",
  '!' || lower(to_hex(REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '')::bigint)) AS "Hex ID",
  REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS "Decimal ID",
  role AS "Hardware Role",
  hardware_model AS "Hardware",
  -- Extract their primary region if available
  TRIM(REPLACE(substring(last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')) AS "MQTT Region",
  last_heard_topic AS "Last Topic"
FROM node_details
WHERE 
  -- Find matches, including the 00/FF quirk!
  MOD(REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '')::numeric, 256) = NULLIF('${relay_byte}', '')::numeric
  OR (NULLIF('${relay_byte}', '')::numeric = 255 AND MOD(REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '')::numeric, 256) = 0)
ORDER BY long_name ASC;

SELECT
  -- We select the raw ID first so we can use it as a hidden Data Link variable
  REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') AS "gateway_id",
  
  -- The friendly name for the UI
  COALESCE(MAX(n.long_name), REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS "Gateway Name",
  COUNT(m.packet_id) AS "Packets Uploaded",
  MAX(m.time) AS "Last Upload Time",
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(m.time))) / 3600)::numeric, 1) || ' hrs ago' AS "Time Since Upload"
FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
LEFT JOIN node_details n ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(n.node_id::text, '!', '')
WHERE m.relay_node = NULLIF('${relay_byte}', '')::numeric
  AND m.reporting_gateway IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "Packets Uploaded" DESC;

WITH Suspects AS (
  -- 1. Get the pool of mathematically matching nodes (handling the FF/00 quirk)
  SELECT
    REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS suspect_id,
    long_name,
    hardware_model
  FROM node_details
  WHERE MOD(REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '')::numeric, 256) = NULLIF('${relay_byte}', '')::numeric
     OR (NULLIF('${relay_byte}', '')::numeric = 255 AND MOD(REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '')::numeric, 256) = 0)
),
DirectContacts AS (
  -- 2. Find every time the selected Gateway heard one of these suspects DIRECTLY (0 hops)
  SELECT
    REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS suspect_id,
    MAX(time) AS last_contact,
    COUNT(packet_id) AS total_direct_packets,
    ROUND(AVG(rx_snr)::numeric, 2) AS avg_snr,
    MAX(rx_snr) AS best_snr,
    MIN(rx_snr) AS worst_snr
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics
  WHERE REPLACE(reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE('${node_id}', '!', '')
    -- 📍 DEFINING "DIRECT": The packet hasn't lost any hops
    AND hop_start = hop_limit 
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1
)

-- 3. Output the final filtered list
SELECT
  s.long_name || ' (!' || lower(to_hex(s.suspect_id::bigint)) || ')' AS "Verified Suspect",
  s.hardware_model AS "Hardware",
  d.last_contact AS "Last Direct RX",
  ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - d.last_contact)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) || ' hrs ago' AS "Time Elapsed",
  d.total_direct_packets AS "Direct Packets Caught",
  d.avg_snr AS "Avg SNR",
  d.best_snr AS "Best SNR",
  d.worst_snr AS "Worst SNR"
FROM Suspects s
-- 📍 Using an INNER JOIN so it ONLY shows suspects this gateway has actually heard!
JOIN DirectContacts d ON s.suspect_id = d.suspect_id
ORDER BY d.last_contact DESC;
